lineage: Widely assessed successor of GandCrab (GOLD GARDEN/GOLD SOUTHFIELD); infrastructure taken down Oct 2021, members arrested by Russia's FSB Jan 2022
summary: REvil/Sodinokibi was a RaaS that appeared in April 2019 exploiting Oracle WebLogic and grew into one of the most prolific double-extortion operations (JBS, Kaseya). Affiliates used vulnerable edge services, RDP brute force, malspam and MSP compromise. The July 2021 Kaseya VSA attack abused CVE-2021-30116 to push a malicious VSA procedure that decoded the payload with certutil, disabled Defender and side-loaded the encryptor through an outdated, signed MsMpEng.exe.
uniqueTraits: Supply-chain/MSP deployment via Kaseya VSA zero-day CVE-2021-30116 and VSA agent procedures
certutil -decode of agent.crt and DLL side-loading of mpsvc.dll through an old signed Windows Defender binary
Privilege escalation exploit CVE-2018-8453 (win32k) embedded in the payload
2021 variants reboot into Safe Mode (-smode) to encrypt with security tools offline
Initial wave exploited Oracle WebLogic CVE-2019-2725
